prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one premium collectible fantasy card artwork for Arcana, a knowledge-themed card game. Portrait 2:3, ideally 1024 x 1536 or higher. Depth, believable stone architecture, beautifully detailed tactile oil-and-gouache painterly illustration, dramatic chiaroscuro, atmospheric forest-green shadows, antique gold and restrained cyan light, aged stone and drifting mist. Keep the important character face, compass and layered bridges readable when the artwork is cropped to its top 60 percent in a trading card. Sophisticated original fantasy book-cover aesthetic matching a dark forest and antique-gold collectible game. Do not use any existing franchise, recognizable fictional character, branded symbol, red eye motif, elf ears, or artist imitation.
